axis.description: An integer or tuple of integers that represent the axis along which a logical AND reduction is performed. The default (`axis=None`) is to perform a logical AND over all the dimensions of the input array. `axis` may be negative, in which case it counts for the last to the first axis.
constraints: axis must be None, a single integer, or a tuple of integers. If axis is a tuple, it represents multiple axes along which a logical AND reduction is performed.

keepdims.description: If `True`, axes which are reduced are left in the result as dimensions with size one. With this option, the result will broadcast correctly against the input array. Defaults to `False`.
constraints: keepdims must be one of True, False

output.description: The tensor containing the logical AND reduction over the `axis`.
